answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a sable-sealed vault bond that a gale of audits keeps honest. Each agent locks 250 POA for 60 days in a vault tied to one hardware key. Every 48 hours it must re-sign a fresh challenge; missing two windows burns 40 POA and suspends it for 21 days. Three staked peers verify each key, and a second identity on the same device triggers an audit slashing the full 250 POA. Faking 1,000 identities costs 250,000 POA locked plus 1,000 hardware keys and 48-hour re-keying — like forging a thousand lighthouse keys while the gale keeps changing the locks.
